basics.name: Adem Toumi
basics.label: AI & Data Science Engineer
basics.summary: AI & Data Science Engineer trained at the Higher School of Computer Science (ESI-SBA), Algeria. Specializing in log anomaly detection, computer vision, natural language processing, explainable AI, and distributed systems.

work.name: Electronic Systems Research and Development Unit (URD Laboratory)
work.position: Research Intern — Object Detection & Tracking for UAV Systems
work.summary: Aerial object detection and multi-object tracking for UAV applications.
highlights: Prepared aerial object-detection datasets (VisDrone, military vehicle imagery) for YOLO-based training and evaluation.
Trained YOLOv11s; evaluated on VisDrone validation set, achieving mAP@0.5 ≈ 0.85.
Implemented DeepSort and CSRT multi-object tracking; assessed edge inference on Raspberry Pi 5 with Intel Movidius NCS 2.
Engineering PFE — Explainable AI for Log Anomaly Detection in Distributed Systems (2024–2025)
Master's Thesis — A Survey on Log-Based Anomaly Detection in Distributed Systems (2025–2026)
Supervisors: Dr. Sidi Mohammed Benslimane (ESI-SBA), Dr. Mohammed Bekkouche (GRESCOM)

publications.name: A Survey on Log-Based Anomaly Detection in Distributed Systems: Methods, Benchmarks, and Explainability
publications.summary: Systematic literature survey and comparative synthesis of log-based anomaly detection methods. Covers session construction, classical ML, unsupervised and supervised DL, and Transformer-based models across HDFS, BGL, and Spirit benchmarks, with SHAP and LIME post-hoc explainability.

publications.name: Explainable AI for Log Anomaly Detection in Distributed Systems
publications.summary: Comprehensive implementation and benchmark of eleven ML and DL models for log-based anomaly detection on HDFS, BGL, and Spirit datasets under a unified experimental protocol with temporal splitting, SHAP/LIME explainability, FastAPI inference on Hugging Face Spaces, and Streamlit real-time monitoring.

projects.name: KnowledgeHub AI — Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Platform
projects.summary: Production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform combining Hybrid Retrieval (FAISS + BM25), Cross-Encoder Reranking, Explainable AI, Google Gemini LLM, and a React interface.
highlights: Hybrid Search combining dense vector search (FAISS) and sparse lexical retrieval (BM25)
Deep Cross-Encoder reranking and Explainable AI (XAI) source attribution
FastAPI REST backend with React Query frontend and Docker containerization

projects.name: Log-Based Anomaly Detection in Distributed Systems
projects.summary: Engineering PFE and Master's Thesis — benchmarked 11 ML/DL models on HDFS, BGL, and Spirit datasets with SHAP/LIME explainability and a real-time Kafka-Streamlit monitoring pipeline.
highlights: Attention-BiLSTM achieving F1=0.9958 on HDFS
Real-time pipeline: Kafka → FastAPI → PostgreSQL → Streamlit
SHAP and LIME post-hoc explainability for every model

projects.name: Object Detection & Tracking for UAV Applications
projects.summary: Academic internship — trained YOLOv11s on VisDrone and military vehicle datasets; implemented DeepSort and CSRT tracking; edge inference on Raspberry Pi 5.
highlights: YOLOv11s mAP@0.5 ≈ 0.85 on VisDrone validation set
Edge inference on Raspberry Pi 5 with Intel Movidius NCS 2

projects.name: HajjPortal — Hajj Pilgrimage Management Platform
projects.summary: Trilingual Next.js 14 platform covering pilgrim registration, hotel reservations, lottery draws, and journey tracking with a separate Socket.io admin dashboard.
highlights: Full Arabic RTL, English, and French support
Real-time admin dashboard with Socket.io

projects.name: KidLink — School Communication Platform
projects.summary: Flutter mobile application for structured parent-teacher communication in primary schools with Firebase services and role-based interfaces.
highlights: Cross-platform iOS and Android with Flutter
Firebase Authentication and Firestore backend

projects.name: Malicious URL Detection using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Comparative study of Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LSTM on 651,191 URLs across four classes using TF-IDF character n-grams; best result Random Forest at 96.8% macro-F1.
highlights: Random Forest 96.8% macro-F1 on four-class classification
651,191 URLs dataset with TF-IDF character n-grams

projects.name: Paraphrase Detection with Siamese Neural Networks
projects.summary: Siamese BiLSTM with 4-head multi-head attention trained on PAWS and Quora Question Pairs with WordNet augmentation and Focal Loss.
highlights: Siamese BiLSTM + 4-head multi-head attention architecture
Trained on PAWS and Quora Question Pairs datasets
